summary: Verify immutable publication evidence before adoption

delivery.outcome: Production adoption records published provenance only after exact annotated-tag and final GitHub Release proof, while explicit test candidates remain truthfully distinguishable, and the complete standard is published as immutable v0.15.0
nonGoals: No weakening of the production lock validator
No network access in unpublished fixture paths
No target-repository mutation before the live read-only pilot
No moving or overwriting an existing tag or Release

architecture.decision: Keep Goal as the supported production entry point, make the pinned generator independently fail closed on exact tag and final Release evidence, and permit only an explicit test flag that records unpublished-test provenance
interfaceChanges: Production create_adoption_lock.py verifies annotated tag and final GitHub Release evidence
The published standard advances from 0.14.1 to 0.15.0
dataChanges: lock.schema.json structurally distinguishes published from unpublished-test provenance
architecture.rollback: Keep adopters pinned to immutable v0.14.1; never move or delete v0.15.0 after publication

validation.evidence: Unpublished normal invocation fails before writes
Explicit candidate fixtures record unpublished-test and the production validator rejects it
Public Goal and the pinned generator accept only the exact final v0.15.0 tag/Release and report read-only target drift

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: Release carriers, supported environments and independent review bind the same candidate
